The best free label maker software

Address labels on sheets, price tags with barcodes and shipping labels on a thermal printer each need a different tool, or one that does all three. Here are four free label designers and what each can print.

We make SlopLabel, one of the tools on this page. Every fact about the other tools comes from their own pages, linked under each one, as they read on 2026-10-24. Prices and features change: check each site before you choose.

How we compared them

  • Free, with no paid licence for the features you need
  • Data merge from a spreadsheet, barcodes and numbering
  • Printing on both label sheets and thermal (Zebra) printers
  • Where it runs and what it needs

1. SlopLabel (ours)

Best for: One free tool for sheets and Zebra printers, with spreadsheet merge and GS1 barcodes, in the browser.

Good

  • Barcodes and QR codes, GS1, with check digits added for you
  • One label per spreadsheet row, quantity column, counters, dates and formulas
  • Avery Letter and A4 sheets by code, thermal rolls or any custom size
  • Writes Zebra ZPL at 152 to 600 dpi and draws a ZPL file to edit; PDF, PNG and SVG export

Not so good

  • Still in beta
  • Old .xls files must be saved as .xlsx or CSV first
  • Direct USB or network printing to a Zebra printer needs a helper such as Zebra Browser Print, or sending the .zpl file
  • Browser printing must be set to 100% scale for sheets to line up

Open SlopLabel

2. Avery Design & Print

Best for: Printing on Avery sheets with ready-made designs and a mail merge.

Good

  • Free online designer matched to Avery products
  • Imports names and addresses from spreadsheets
  • Barcode and QR code generator with sequential numbering
  • Images from your computer, Avery's gallery or Google Photos; PDF download

Not so good

  • Made for Avery sheet products; thermal printers are not mentioned
  • Sequential numbering does not work with UPC-A or EAN-13
  • The offline desktop software was retired in 2020

Avery Design & Print website · Sources: Avery Design & Print, Avery help: without an account, Avery help: QR and barcodes, Avery help: sequential numbering, Avery help: offline software, Avery help: barcode types, Avery help: export files, Avery terms and conditions

3. ZebraDesigner 3 Essentials

Best for: Zebra printer owners on Windows who design simple barcode labels by hand.

Good

  • Free WYSIWYG barcode label design for all Zebra Link-OS printers
  • GS1-128 wizard, templates and counters
  • Print to file gives a ZPL .prn file
  • 20 interface languages

Not so good

  • Windows only
  • Excel, Access and other database connections are in the paid Professional edition

ZebraDesigner 3 Essentials website · Sources: ZebraDesigner product page, ZebraDesigner 3 downloads and requirements, Zebra support: PRN file, ZebraDesigner 3 Essentials user guide, Zebra software licence

4. gLabels

Best for: Linux users who want a free, open source label and business card designer with CSV merge.

Good

  • Text, images, lines, shapes and barcodes on labels and business cards
  • Simple document merge from CSV
  • Template database including Avery sheets
  • Open source

Not so good

  • Version 3 has not been supported since 2018; version 4 has no official release and must be built from source
  • Windows and macOS only through version 4 builds

gLabels website · Sources: gLabels home, gLabels 4 on GitHub, gLabels Avery templates, gLabels barcode backends (source), gLabels user variables

Which one to choose

SlopLabel is first because it is the only one here that does spreadsheet merge on Avery sheets and Zebra ZPL for free, in any browser. It is in beta, and printing straight to a Zebra printer needs a helper.

For Avery sheets alone, Avery Design & Print is the official, polished choice. ZebraDesigner Essentials is the natural free start for Zebra owners on Windows, though data merge needs the paid edition. gLabels suits Linux users.

Questions

Is there free label software with mail merge?

Yes. SlopLabel, Avery Design & Print and gLabels merge from spreadsheets for free. ZebraDesigner has database connections only in its paid Professional edition.

Which free label software works with Zebra printers?

ZebraDesigner 3 Essentials prints to Zebra Link-OS printers on Windows. SlopLabel writes ZPL in a browser on any system, and the file can be sent to the printer.

Can I make Avery labels for free?

Yes. Avery Design & Print is Avery's own free tool. SlopLabel and gLabels also include Avery sheet layouts by their codes.

Do I need an account?

Not for SlopLabel or ZebraDesigner Essentials. Avery works without one through its shortcut page, but saving online needs an account.
